context_diary: The Tenant Platform uses a hierarchical structure where CURRENCY_AGENT type accounts (not standard AGENT) serve as parent nodes for USER accounts. The account_lookup function can filter by type including ADMIN, USER, and CURRENCY_AGENT. The traverse_hierarchy function reveals parent-child relationships, while generate_aggregation_report efficiently counts large datasets without token overflow. When querying large hierarchies, use aggregation functions with count metrics rather than traversing all children directly, as the latter can exceed context limits with thousands of records.
